data.narrative:
Atomic AI is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Raphael Townshend that has raised $42M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods tested, only stage-progression proved applicable. This approach uses the company's $42M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $84M. Peer-median anchoring was not feasible due to insufficient narrow-filter comparables within the Biotech & Health sector—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of 3 datapoints when filtered by stage and tier. Public-company P/S anchoring could not proceed because target revenue is not disclosed, a standard constraint for private companies.

The triangulated valuation range is $71M to $97M, with a median point of $84M. This range reflects the methodological constraints inherent in early-stage biotech analysis: sparse proprietary financial disclosure and a fragmented peer universe. The primary uncertainty lies in the applicability of the 2.0x step-up multiplier to this specific company and sector; validation would require more granular comparable data on dilution and round sizing within frontier biotech.
